mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leaves( applicant_id, leave_type_id, flow_id, start_date, end_date, reason, status ) VALUES( #{applicantId}, #{leaveTypeId}, #{approvalFlowId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{reason}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE leaves SET status = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, lt.name AS leaveTypeName, l.start_date, l.end_date, l.status, l.created_at FROM leaves l JOIN leave_types lt ON l.leave_type_id = lt.id WHERE l.applicant_id = #{applicantId} ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
SELECT l.id, lt.name AS leaveTypeName, l.start_date, l.end_date, l.reason, l.status, l.created_at, l.updated_at FROM leaves l JOIN leave_types lt ON l.leave_type_id = lt.id WHERE l.id = #{id}
